name: Smoothness Terms for Neural Marching Cubes
aliases: Regularization terms for NMC surface smoothness
definition: A set of loss functions ($L_{smooth}$) used to regularize the generated surfaces in Neural Marching Cubes (NMC) to resolve ambiguities in shapes represented by binary voxels and prevent artifacts.
summary: Smoothness terms for Neural Marching Cubes are edge-level loss functions that resolve binary voxel ambiguities and prevent geometric artifacts by penalizing specific mesh edge properties during training.
